provenance: Read-only production function catalog, 2026-10-12. Definitions only, no production employee data or credentials. Used only in isolated synthetic regression fixtures.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_user_offboarding_execute(p_departing_finance_user_id text, p_successor_finance_user_id text, p_reason text, p_expected_revision text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor public.finance_users%rowtype;
  v_departing public.finance_users%rowtype;
  v_successor public.finance_users%rowtype;
  v_existing private.finance_user_offboarding_operations%rowtype;
  v_preview jsonb;
  v_requires_successor boolean;
  v_operation_id text := 'off_' || pg_catalog.replace(
    pg_catalog.gen_random_uuid()::text,
    '-',
    ''
  );
  v_reason text := pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(p_reason, ''));
  v_departing_supervisor_id text;
  v_successor_is_descendant boolean := false;
  v_rows jsonb;
  v_publish jsonb;
  v_result jsonb;
  v_source record;
  v_moved_step_count integer := 0;
  v_updated_form_count integer := 0;
  v_direct_report_count integer := 0;
  v_delegate_route_count integer := 0;
  v_closed_delegation_count integer := 0;
  v_revoked_assignment_count integer := 0;
  v_cancelled_notification_count integer := 0;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception '請先使用公司 Google 帳號登入後再執行離職交接'
      using errcode = '28000';
  end if;

  v_actor := public.current_finance_user();
  if v_actor.id is null or v_actor.active is distinct from true then
    raise exception '目前登入帳號沒有有效的 Finance 人員身分'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if v_actor.role not in ('ceo', 'admin_director', 'hr') then
    raise exception '只有執行長、行政部門主任或人資可執行離職交接'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(p_departing_finance_user_id), '') is null then
    raise exception '請選擇要辦理離職交接的人員'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  if v_actor.id = p_departing_finance_user_id then
    raise exception '不能停用目前登入中的自己'
      using errcode = '42501', detail = 'CANNOT_OFFBOARD_SELF';
  end if;
  if pg_catalog.char_length(v_reason) not between 3 and 500 then
    raise exception '請填寫至少 3 個字且不超過 500 字的離職／交接原因'
      using errcode = '22023', detail = 'OFFBOARDING_REASON_TOO_SHORT';
  end if;
  if nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(p_expected_revision), '') is null then
    raise exception '缺少離職交接預覽版本，請重新檢查後再執行'
      using errcode = '22023', detail = 'OFFBOARDING_PREVIEW_STALE';
  end if;

  perform pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(
    pg_catalog.hashtextextended(
      'finance-user-offboarding:' || v_actor.tenant_id::text || ':' ||
      p_departing_finance_user_id,
      0
    )
  );

  select operation_row.*
    into v_existing
  from private.finance_user_offboarding_operations operation_row
  where operation_row.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
    and operation_row.departing_finance_user_id = p_departing_finance_user_id
    and operation_row.preview_revision = p_expected_revision
  limit 1;

  if found then
    if v_existing.successor_finance_user_id is not distinct from
         nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(p_successor_finance_user_id), '')
       and v_existing.reason = v_reason then
      return v_existing.result || pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
        'idempotent', true,
        'operation_id', v_existing.id
      );
    end if;
    raise exception '相同預覽版本已用不同接手人或原因完成交接'
      using errcode = '23505', detail = 'OFFBOARDING_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT';
  end if;

  -- Deterministic user locks avoid a target/successor lock inversion.
  perform 1
  from public.finance_users finance_user
  where finance_user.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
    and finance_user.id in (
      p_departing_finance_user_id,
      coalesce(nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(p_successor_finance_user_id), ''),
               p_departing_finance_user_id)
    )
  order by finance_user.id
  for update;

  select finance_user.*
    into v_departing
  from public.finance_users finance_user
  where finance_user.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
    and finance_user.id = p_departing_finance_user_id
  limit 1;

  if not found then
    raise exception '找不到這位離職人員，請重新整理人員名單後再試'
      using errcode = 'P0002', detail = 'DEPARTING_USER_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  if v_departing.active is distinct from true then
    raise exception '這位人員目前不是啟用狀態，不需要再次執行離職交接'
      using errcode = '55000', detail = 'DEPARTING_USER_NOT_ACTIVE';
  end if;
  if v_departing.role = 'ceo' then
    raise exception '執行長必須改走專用的執行長交接程序'
      using errcode = '42501', detail = 'CEO_HANDOFF_REQUIRED';
  end if;
  if v_actor.role = 'hr'
     and v_departing.role in (
       'admin_director',
       'accountant',
       'cashier',
       'hr',
       'external_audit',
       'board',
       'shareholder'
     ) then
    raise exception '人資不能停用會計控制角色，請由執行長或行政部門主任執行'
      using errcode = '42501',
            detail = 'HR_CONTROL_ROLE_REQUIRES_EXECUTIVE';
  end if;
  if lower(coalesce(v_departing.org_status, 'active')) = 'system_account' then
    raise exception '系統帳號不能使用一般人員離職交接'
      using errcode = '42501', detail = 'SYSTEM_ACCOUNT_NOT_SUPPORTED';
  end if;

  -- Lock every relationship/delegation row that participates in revision.
  perform 1
  from public.employee_department_roles assignment
  where assignment.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
    and assignment.active is true
    and (
      assignment.finance_user_id = p_departing_finance_user_id
      or assignment.direct_supervisor_finance_user_id = p_departing_finance_user_id
      or assignment.approval_delegate_finance_user_id = p_departing_finance_user_id
      or assignment.metadata ->> 'intended_supervisor_finance_user_id' = p_departing_finance_user_id
      or assignment.metadata ->> 'direct_supervisor_finance_user_id' = p_departing_finance_user_id
      or assignment.metadata ->> 'supervisor_finance_user_id' = p_departing_finance_user_id
      or assignment.metadata ->> 'supervisor_id' = p_departing_finance_user_id
    )
  order by assignment.id
  for update;

  -- Lock the selected successor's approval capability before recomputing the
  -- revision so it cannot disappear between validation and reassignment.
  if nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(p_successor_finance_user_id), '') is not null then
    perform 1
    from public.employee_department_roles assignment
    where assignment.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
      and assignment.finance_user_id = p_successor_finance_user_id
    order by assignment.id
    for update;
  end if;

  perform 1
  from public.approval_delegations delegation
  where delegation.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
    and delegation.active is true
    and (
      delegation.delegator_finance_user_id = p_departing_finance_user_id
      or delegation.delegatee_finance_user_id = p_departing_finance_user_id
    )
  order by delegation.id
  for update;

  -- These scans happen after the Finance user lock. Concurrent submit/update
  -- triggers must first take a key-share lock and therefore cannot slip a new
  -- assignment between this scan and deactivation.
  perform 1
  from public.expense_requests source_row
  where source_row.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
    and lower(coalesce(source_row.status, '')) like 'pending%'
    and exists (
      select 1
      from pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(source_row.steps, '[]'::jsonb)) source_step(step)
      where coalesce(source_step.step ->> 'a', '') = ''
        and (
          nullif(source_step.step ->> 'uid', '') = p_departing_finance_user_id
          or (
            nullif(source_step.step ->> 'uid', '') is null
            and lower(coalesce(source_step.step ->> 'email', '')) = lower(v_departing.email)
          )
        )
    )
  order by source_row.id
  for update;

  perform 1
  from public.invoices source_row
  where source_row.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
    and lower(coalesce(source_row.approval_status, '')) like 'pending%'
    and exists (
      select 1
      from pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(source_row.steps, '[]'::jsonb)) source_step(step)
      where coalesce(source_step.step ->> 'a', '') = ''
        and (
          nullif(source_step.step ->> 'uid', '') = p_departing_finance_user_id
          or (
            nullif(source_step.step ->> 'uid', '') is null
            and lower(coalesce(source_step.step ->> 'email', '')) = lower(v_departing.email)
          )
        )
    )
  order by source_row.id
  for update;

  perform 1
  from public.bills source_row
  where source_row.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
    and lower(coalesce(source_row.approval_status, '')) like 'pending%'
    and exists (
      select 1
      from pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(source_row.steps, '[]'::jsonb)) source_step(step)
      where coalesce(source_step.step ->> 'a', '') = ''
        and (
          nullif(source_step.step ->> 'uid', '') = p_departing_finance_user_id
          or (
            nullif(source_step.step ->> 'uid', '') is null
            and lower(coalesce(source_step.step ->> 'email', '')) = lower(v_departing.email)
          )
        )
    )
  order by source_row.id
  for update;

  v_preview := private.finance_user_offboarding_preview_for_tenant(
    v_actor.tenant_id,
    p_departing_finance_user_id
  );

  if coalesce(v_preview ->> 'revision', '') <> p_expected_revision then
    raise exception '待簽單或主管關係剛剛已有變動，請重新檢查後再執行'
      using errcode = '40001', detail = 'OFFBOARDING_PREVIEW_STALE';
  end if;
  if pg_catalog.jsonb_array_length(coalesce(v_preview -> 'blockers', '[]'::jsonb)) > 0 then
    raise exception '離職交接仍有阻斷項目，請重新檢查後處理'
      using errcode = '55000',
            detail = coalesce(v_preview -> 'blockers', '[]'::jsonb)::text;
  end if;

  v_requires_successor := coalesce((v_preview ->> 'requires_successor')::boolean, false);
  if v_requires_successor
     and nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(p_successor_finance_user_id), '') is null then
    raise exception '仍有待簽單或主管關係，必須選擇接手人'
      using errcode = '22023', detail = 'SUCCESSOR_REQUIRED';
  end if;
  if nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(p_successor_finance_user_id), '') = p_departing_finance_user_id then
    raise exception '接手人不能是離職人員本人'
      using errcode = '22023', detail = 'SUCCESSOR_NOT_ELIGIBLE';
  end if;

  if nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(p_successor_finance_user_id), '') is not null then
    if not exists (
      select 1
      from pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(
        coalesce(v_preview -> 'eligible_successors', '[]'::jsonb)
      ) candidate(item)
      where coalesce(candidate.item ->> 'finance_user_id', candidate.item ->> 'id') =
            p_successor_finance_user_id
    ) then
      raise exception '所選接手人目前不具備完整簽核資格或會形成自行簽核'
        using errcode = '22023', detail = 'SUCCESSOR_NOT_ELIGIBLE';
    end if;

    select finance_user.*
      into v_successor
    from public.finance_users finance_user
    where finance_user.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
      and finance_user.id = p_successor_finance_user_id
      and finance_user.active is true
    limit 1;

    if not found
       or not public.finance_org_signer_is_runtime_ready(
         v_actor.tenant_id,
         p_successor_finance_user_id
       ) then
      raise exception '所選接手人目前不具備完整簽核資格'
        using errcode = '22023', detail = 'SUCCESSOR_NOT_ELIGIBLE';
    end if;
  end if;

  v_moved_step_count := coalesce((v_preview #>> '{counts,steps}')::integer, 0);
  v_updated_form_count := coalesce((v_preview #>> '{counts,documents}')::integer, 0);
  v_direct_report_count := coalesce((v_preview #>> '{counts,direct_reports}')::integer, 0);
  v_delegate_route_count := coalesce((v_preview #>> '{counts,delegate_routes}')::integer, 0);

  if v_moved_step_count > 0 and v_successor.id is null then
    raise exception '待簽關卡需要有效接手人'
      using errcode = '22023', detail = 'SUCCESSOR_REQUIRED';
  end if;

  -- The deferred operation FK lets all immutable item evidence be inserted
  -- before the final result/header without ever updating an audit record.
  insert into private.finance_user_offboarding_items (
    operation_id,
    tenant_id,
    item_type,
    record_type,
    record_id,
    record_no,
    step_index,
    before_state,
    after_state,
    metadata
  )
  select
    v_operation_id,
    v_actor.tenant_id,
    'approval_step_reassigned',
    affected.source_table,
    affected.record_id,
    affected.record_no,
    affected.step_index,
    affected.step_payload,
    private.finance_user_offboarding_rewrite_steps(
      pg_catalog.jsonb_build_array(affected.step_payload),
      p_departing_finance_user_id,
      v_departing.email,
      v_successor.id,
      v_successor.email,
      v_operation_id,
      v_actor.id,
      v_reason
    ) -> 0,
    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'is_active', affected.is_active,
      'applicant_id', affected.applicant_id,
      'workflow_status', affected.workflow_status,
      'active_step_index', affected.active_step_index
    )
  from private.finance_user_offboarding_affected_steps(
    v_actor.tenant_id,
    p_departing_finance_user_id
  ) affected;

  perform pg_catalog.set_config(
    'app.finance_expense_write_context',
    'offboarding_transfer',
    true
  );

  update public.expense_requests source_row
  set steps = private.finance_user_offboarding_rewrite_steps(
        source_row.steps,
        p_departing_finance_user_id,
        v_departing.email,
        v_successor.id,
        v_successor.email,
        v_operation_id,
        v_actor.id,
        v_reason
      ),
      ver = coalesce(source_row.ver, 1) + 1,
      updated_at = pg_catalog.now()
  where source_row.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
    and exists (
      select 1
      from private.finance_user_offboarding_items audit_item
      where audit_item.operation_id = v_operation_id
        and audit_item.record_type = 'expense_requests'
        and audit_item.record_id = source_row.id
    );

  update public.invoices source_row
  set steps = private.finance_user_offboarding_rewrite_steps(
        source_row.steps,
        p_departing_finance_user_id,
        v_departing.email,
        v_successor.id,
        v_successor.email,
        v_operation_id,
        v_actor.id,
        v_reason
      ),
      updated_at = pg_catalog.now()
  where source_row.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
    and exists (
      select 1
      from private.finance_user_offboarding_items audit_item
      where audit_item.operation_id = v_operation_id
        and audit_item.record_type = 'invoices'
        and audit_item.record_id = source_row.id
    );

  update public.bills source_row
  set steps = private.finance_user_offboarding_rewrite_steps(
        source_row.steps,
        p_departing_finance_user_id,
        v_departing.email,
        v_successor.id,
        v_successor.email,
        v_operation_id,
        v_actor.id,
        v_reason
      )
  where source_row.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
    and exists (
      select 1
      from private.finance_user_offboarding_items audit_item
      where audit_item.operation_id = v_operation_id
        and audit_item.record_type = 'bills'
        and audit_item.record_id = source_row.id
    );

  for v_source in
    select
      'expense_requests'::text as source_table,
      source_row.id,
      source_row.no,
      source_row.entity_id,
      source_row.department_code,
      source_row.steps,
      source_row.data_environment
    from public.expense_requests source_row
    where source_row.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
      and exists (
        select 1
        from private.finance_user_offboarding_items audit_item
        where audit_item.operation_id = v_operation_id
          and audit_item.record_type = 'expense_requests'
          and audit_item.record_id = source_row.id
      )

    union all

    select
      'invoices',
      source_row.id,
      coalesce(source_row.no, source_row.id),
      source_row.entity_id,
      source_row.department_code,
      source_row.steps,
      source_row.data_environment
    from public.invoices source_row
    where source_row.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
      and exists (
        select 1
        from private.finance_user_offboarding_items audit_item
        where audit_item.operation_id = v_operation_id
          and audit_item.record_type = 'invoices'
          and audit_item.record_id = source_row.id
      )

    union all

    select
      'bills',
      source_row.id,
      coalesce(source_row.no, source_row.id),
      source_row.entity_id,
      source_row.department_code,
      source_row.steps,
      source_row.data_environment
    from public.bills source_row
    where source_row.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
      and exists (
        select 1
        from private.finance_user_offboarding_items audit_item
        where audit_item.operation_id = v_operation_id
          and audit_item.record_type = 'bills'
          and audit_item.record_id = source_row.id
      )
    order by 1, 2
  loop
    perform private.rebuild_approval_step_actor_snapshots(
      v_source.source_table,
      v_source.id,
      v_source.no,
      v_source.steps,
      v_source.data_environment,
      v_source.entity_id,
      v_source.department_code,
      v_actor.tenant_id
    );
  end loop;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from private.finance_user_offboarding_items audit_item
    where audit_item.operation_id = v_operation_id
      and audit_item.item_type = 'approval_step_reassigned'
      and not exists (
        select 1
        from public.approval_step_actor_snapshots snapshot_row
        where snapshot_row.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
          and snapshot_row.record_type = audit_item.record_type
          and snapshot_row.record_id = audit_item.record_id
          and snapshot_row.step_index = audit_item.step_index
          and snapshot_row.raw_actor_user_id = v_successor.id
          and snapshot_row.resolved_user_id = v_successor.id
          and snapshot_row.resolution_status = 'resolved'
      )
  ) then
    raise exception '簽核人快照重建驗證失敗，離職交接已全部回滾'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  if pg_catalog.to_regclass('public.notification_delivery_events') is not null then
    update public.notification_delivery_events notification_event
    set status = 'skipped',
        next_retry_at = null,
        locked_at = null,
        locked_by = null,
        last_error = '簽核已因離職交接轉派',
        retry_history = coalesce(notification_event.retry_history, '[]'::jsonb)
          || pg_catalog.jsonb_build_array(
            pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
              'at', pg_catalog.now(),
              'status', 'skipped',
              'reason', '簽核已因離職交接轉派',
              'operation_id', v_operation_id
            )
          )
    where notification_event.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
      and notification_event.status in ('pending', 'failed')
      and notification_event.payload ->> 'recipient_finance_user_id' =
          p_departing_finance_user_id
      and exists (
        select 1
        from private.finance_user_offboarding_items audit_item
        where audit_item.operation_id = v_operation_id
          and audit_item.item_type = 'approval_step_reassigned'
          and coalesce((audit_item.metadata ->> 'is_active')::boolean, false)
          and notification_event.payload ->> 'source_table' = audit_item.record_type
          and notification_event.payload ->> 'source_id' = audit_item.record_id
          and coalesce((notification_event.payload ->> 'approval_step')::integer, 0) =
              audit_item.step_index
      );
    get diagnostics v_cancelled_notification_count = row_count;
  end if;

  select assignment.direct_supervisor_finance_user_id
    into v_departing_supervisor_id
  from public.employee_department_roles assignment
  where assignment.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
    and assignment.finance_user_id = p_departing_finance_user_id
    and assignment.active is true
  order by assignment.is_primary desc,
           assignment.updated_at desc nulls last,
           assignment.created_at desc nulls last,
           assignment.id
  limit 1;

  if v_successor.id is not null then
    with recursive descendants(finance_user_id) as (
      select distinct assignment.finance_user_id
      from public.employee_department_roles assignment
      where assignment.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
        and assignment.active is true
        and assignment.direct_supervisor_finance_user_id =
            p_departing_finance_user_id

      union

      select distinct child.finance_user_id
      from public.employee_department_roles child
      join descendants parent
        on child.direct_supervisor_finance_user_id = parent.finance_user_id
      where child.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
        and child.active is true
    )
    select exists (
      select 1 from descendants
      where descendants.finance_user_id = v_successor.id
    ) into v_successor_is_descendant;
  end if;

  if v_successor_is_descendant then
    insert into private.finance_user_offboarding_items (
      operation_id, tenant_id, item_type, record_type, record_id,
      before_state, after_state, metadata
    )
    select
      v_operation_id,
      v_actor.tenant_id,
      'successor_reparented_to_break_cycle',
      'employee_department_roles',
      assignment.id,
      pg_catalog.to_jsonb(assignment),
      pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
        'direct_supervisor_finance_user_id', v_departing_supervisor_id,
        'reason', '離職交接接手人原在離職人員主管鏈下，先改掛上一層以避免循環'
      ),
      pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('finance_user_id', v_successor.id)
    from public.employee_department_roles assignment
    where assignment.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
      and assignment.finance_user_id = v_successor.id
      and assignment.active is true;

    update public.employee_department_roles assignment
    set direct_supervisor_finance_user_id = v_departing_supervisor_id,
        metadata = (
          assignment.metadata
          - 'supervisor_pending_google_bind'
          - 'supervisor_pending_activation'
        ) || pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
          'intended_supervisor_finance_user_id', v_departing_supervisor_id,
          'direct_supervisor_finance_user_id', v_departing_supervisor_id,
          'supervisor_finance_user_id', v_departing_supervisor_id,
          'supervisor_id', v_departing_supervisor_id,
          'offboarding_cycle_break_operation_id', v_operation_id,
          'offboarding_cycle_break_at', pg_catalog.now()
        ),
        updated_at = pg_catalog.now()
    where assignment.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
      and assignment.finance_user_id = v_successor.id
      and assignment.active is true;
  end if;

  if v_successor.id is not null then
    insert into private.finance_user_offboarding_items (
      operation_id, tenant_id, item_type, record_type, record_id,
      before_state, after_state, metadata
    )
    select
      v_operation_id,
      v_actor.tenant_id,
      'direct_supervisor_reassigned',
      'employee_department_roles',
      assignment.id,
      pg_catalog.to_jsonb(assignment),
      pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
        'direct_supervisor_finance_user_id', v_successor.id,
        'successor_name', v_successor.name
      ),
      pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
        'finance_user_id', assignment.finance_user_id
      )
    from public.employee_department_roles assignment
    where assignment.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
      and assignment.active is true
      and assignment.finance_user_id <> p_departing_finance_user_id
      and assignment.finance_user_id <> v_successor.id
      and (
        assignment.direct_supervisor_finance_user_id = p_departing_finance_user_id
        or assignment.metadata ->> 'intended_supervisor_finance_user_id' = p_departing_finance_user_id
        or assignment.metadata ->> 'direct_supervisor_finance_user_id' = p_departing_finance_user_id
        or assignment.metadata ->> 'supervisor_finance_user_id' = p_departing_finance_user_id
        or assignment.metadata ->> 'supervisor_id' = p_departing_finance_user_id
      );

    update public.employee_department_roles assignment
    set direct_supervisor_finance_user_id = v_successor.id,
        metadata = pg_catalog.jsonb_set(
          pg_catalog.jsonb_set(
            pg_catalog.jsonb_set(
              pg_catalog.jsonb_set(
                assignment.metadata
                  - 'supervisor_pending_google_bind'
                  - 'supervisor_pending_activation',
                '{intended_supervisor_finance_user_id}',
                case
                  when assignment.metadata ->> 'intended_supervisor_finance_user_id' =
                       p_departing_finance_user_id
                    then pg_catalog.to_jsonb(v_successor.id)
                  else coalesce(
                    assignment.metadata -> 'intended_supervisor_finance_user_id',
                    'null'::jsonb
                  )
                end,
                true
              ),
              '{direct_supervisor_finance_user_id}',
              case
                when assignment.metadata ->> 'direct_supervisor_finance_user_id' =
                     p_departing_finance_user_id
                  then pg_catalog.to_jsonb(v_successor.id)
                else coalesce(
                  assignment.metadata -> 'direct_supervisor_finance_user_id',
                  'null'::jsonb
                )
              end,
              true
            ),
            '{supervisor_finance_user_id}',
            case
              when assignment.metadata ->> 'supervisor_finance_user_id' =
                   p_departing_finance_user_id
                then pg_catalog.to_jsonb(v_successor.id)
              else coalesce(
                assignment.metadata -> 'supervisor_finance_user_id',
                'null'::jsonb
              )
            end,
            true
          ),
          '{supervisor_id}',
          case
            when assignment.metadata ->> 'supervisor_id' = p_departing_finance_user_id
              then pg_catalog.to_jsonb(v_successor.id)
            else coalesce(assignment.metadata -> 'supervisor_id', 'null'::jsonb)
          end,
          true
        ) || pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
          'offboarding_supervisor_operation_id', v_operation_id,
          'offboarding_supervisor_updated_at', pg_catalog.now()
        ),
        updated_at = pg_catalog.now()
    where assignment.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
      and assignment.active is true
      and assignment.finance_user_id <> p_departing_finance_user_id
      and assignment.finance_user_id <> v_successor.id
      and (
        assignment.direct_supervisor_finance_user_id = p_departing_finance_user_id
        or assignment.metadata ->> 'intended_supervisor_finance_user_id' = p_departing_finance_user_id
        or assignment.metadata ->> 'direct_supervisor_finance_user_id' = p_departing_finance_user_id
        or assignment.metadata ->> 'supervisor_finance_user_id' = p_departing_finance_user_id
        or assignment.metadata ->> 'supervisor_id' = p_departing_finance_user_id
      );
  end if;

  insert into private.finance_user_offboarding_items (
    operation_id, tenant_id, item_type, record_type, record_id,
    before_state, after_state, metadata
  )
  select
    v_operation_id,
    v_actor.tenant_id,
    'approval_delegate_route_revoked',
    'employee_department_roles',
    assignment.id,
    pg_catalog.to_jsonb(assignment),
    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'approval_delegate_finance_user_id', null,
      'reason', '離職交接不自動授予廣泛代理權'
    ),
    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('finance_user_id', assignment.finance_user_id)
  from public.employee_department_roles assignment
  where assignment.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
    and assignment.active is true
    and assignment.approval_delegate_finance_user_id = p_departing_finance_user_id;

  update public.employee_department_roles assignment
  set approval_delegate_finance_user_id = null,
      metadata = assignment.metadata || pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
        'offboarding_delegate_revoked_operation_id', v_operation_id,
        'offboarding_delegate_revoked_at', pg_catalog.now()
      ),
      updated_at = pg_catalog.now()
  where assignment.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
    and assignment.active is true
    and assignment.approval_delegate_finance_user_id = p_departing_finance_user_id;

  insert into private.finance_user_offboarding_items (
    operation_id, tenant_id, item_type, record_type, record_id,
    before_state, after_state, metadata
  )
  select
    v_operation_id,
    v_actor.tenant_id,
    'approval_delegation_closed',
    'approval_delegations',
    delegation.id,
    pg_catalog.to_jsonb(delegation),
    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'active', false,
      'reason', '離職交接關閉原代理；未授權接手人廣泛代理'
    ),
    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'departing_as_delegator',
        delegation.delegator_finance_user_id = p_departing_finance_user_id,
      'departing_as_delegatee',
        delegation.delegatee_finance_user_id = p_departing_finance_user_id
    )
  from public.approval_delegations delegation
  where delegation.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
    and delegation.active is true
    and (
      delegation.delegator_finance_user_id = p_departing_finance_user_id
      or delegation.delegatee_finance_user_id = p_departing_finance_user_id
    );

  update public.approval_delegations delegation
  set active = false,
      ends_at = case
        when delegation.starts_at < pg_catalog.now() then pg_catalog.now()
        else delegation.starts_at + interval '1 microsecond'
      end,
      reason = concat_ws(
        '；',
        nullif(delegation.reason, ''),
        '離職交接關閉（' || v_reason || '）'
      ),
      updated_at = pg_catalog.now()
  where delegation.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
    and delegation.active is true
    and (
      delegation.delegator_finance_user_id = p_departing_finance_user_id
      or delegation.delegatee_finance_user_id = p_departing_finance_user_id
    );
  get diagnostics v_closed_delegation_count = row_count;

  insert into private.finance_user_offboarding_items (
    operation_id, tenant_id, item_type, record_type, record_id,
    before_state, after_state, metadata
  )
  select
    v_operation_id,
    v_actor.tenant_id,
    'departing_assignment_revoked',
    'employee_department_roles',
    assignment.id,
    pg_catalog.to_jsonb(assignment),
    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'active', false,
      'can_approve', false,
      'effective_to', greatest(assignment.effective_from, current_date)
    ),
    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'finance_user_id', p_departing_finance_user_id
    )
  from public.employee_department_roles assignment
  where assignment.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
    and assignment.finance_user_id = p_departing_finance_user_id
    and assignment.active is true;

  update public.employee_department_roles assignment
  set active = false,
      can_approve = false,
      effective_to = case
        when assignment.effective_to is null
          or assignment.effective_to > current_date
          then greatest(assignment.effective_from, current_date)
        else assignment.effective_to
      end,
      metadata = assignment.metadata || pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
        'offboarding_operation_id', v_operation_id,
        'offboarding_reason', v_reason,
        'offboarded_at', pg_catalog.now(),
        'offboarded_by', v_actor.id
      ),
      updated_at = pg_catalog.now()
  where assignment.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
    and assignment.finance_user_id = p_departing_finance_user_id
    and assignment.active is true;
  get diagnostics v_revoked_assignment_count = row_count;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.employee_department_roles assignment
    where assignment.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
      and assignment.active is true
      and (
        assignment.finance_user_id = p_departing_finance_user_id
        or assignment.direct_supervisor_finance_user_id = p_departing_finance_user_id
        or assignment.approval_delegate_finance_user_id = p_departing_finance_user_id
        or assignment.metadata ->> 'intended_supervisor_finance_user_id' = p_departing_finance_user_id
        or assignment.metadata ->> 'direct_supervisor_finance_user_id' = p_departing_finance_user_id
        or assignment.metadata ->> 'supervisor_finance_user_id' = p_departing_finance_user_id
        or assignment.metadata ->> 'supervisor_id' = p_departing_finance_user_id
      )
  ) then
    raise exception '仍有主管或代理關係指向離職人員，交接已全部回滾'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.approval_delegations delegation
    where delegation.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
      and delegation.active is true
      and (
        delegation.delegator_finance_user_id = p_departing_finance_user_id
        or delegation.delegatee_finance_user_id = p_departing_finance_user_id
      )
  ) then
    raise exception '仍有有效代理關係指向離職人員，交接已全部回滾'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  if public.finance_user_has_frozen_pending_assignee(
       v_actor.tenant_id,
       p_departing_finance_user_id
     ) then
    raise exception '仍有待簽關卡指向離職人員，交接已全部回滾'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  update public.finance_users finance_user
  set active = false,
      org_status = 'inactive',
      org_source = 'finance_user_offboarding',
      org_source_updated_at = pg_catalog.now()
  where finance_user.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
    and finance_user.id = p_departing_finance_user_id
    and finance_user.active is true;

  if not found then
    raise exception '離職人員停用失敗，交接已全部回滾'
      using errcode = '55000';
  end if;

  update public.tenant_members tenant_member
  set active = false,
      updated_at = pg_catalog.now()
  where tenant_member.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
    and tenant_member.finance_user_id = p_departing_finance_user_id
    and tenant_member.active is true;

  select public.finance_org_chart_rows_for_tenant(v_actor.tenant_id)
    into v_rows;
  v_publish := private.finance_write_org_chart_snapshot_version(
    v_actor.tenant_id,
    v_rows,
    v_actor.id,
    '離職交接：' || v_departing.name || ' → ' ||
      coalesce(v_successor.name, '無需接手人'),
    'production'
  );

  if coalesce((v_publish ->> 'ok')::boolean, false) is not true then
    raise exception '組織圖相容快照發布失敗，交接已全部回滾'
      using errcode = '55000';
  end if;

  insert into private.finance_user_offboarding_items (
    operation_id, tenant_id, item_type, record_type, record_id,
    before_state, after_state, metadata
  )
  select
    v_operation_id,
    v_actor.tenant_id,
    'finance_user_deactivated',
    'finance_users',
    v_departing.id,
    pg_catalog.to_jsonb(v_departing) - array['demo_password']::text[],
    pg_catalog.to_jsonb(finance_user) - array['demo_password']::text[],
    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'google_workspace_action_required', true,
      'organization_version_id', v_publish ->> 'version_id'
    )
  from public.finance_users finance_user
  where finance_user.tenant_id = v_actor.tenant_id
    and finance_user.id = p_departing_finance_user_id;

  v_result := pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'contract_version', 1,
    'operation_id', v_operation_id,
    'idempotent', false,
    'revision', p_expected_revision,
    'deactivated', true,
    'moved_step_count', v_moved_step_count,
    'updated_form_count', v_updated_form_count,
    'reassigned_direct_report_count', v_direct_report_count,
    'reassigned_delegate_route_count', 0,
    'revoked_delegate_route_count', v_delegate_route_count,
    'closed_delegation_count', v_closed_delegation_count,
    'created_delegation_count', 0,
    'revoked_assignment_count', v_revoked_assignment_count,
    'cancelled_notification_count', v_cancelled_notification_count,
    'google_account_action_required', true,
    'external_actions', pg_catalog.jsonb_build_array(
      '請由 Google Workspace 管理員停用離職人員的公司 Google 帳號。'
    )
  );

  insert into private.finance_user_offboarding_operations (
    id,
    tenant_id,
    departing_finance_user_id,
    successor_finance_user_id,
    actor_finance_user_id,
    reason,
    preview_revision,
    result
  )
  values (
    v_operation_id,
    v_actor.tenant_id,
    p_departing_finance_user_id,
    nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(p_successor_finance_user_id), ''),
    v_actor.id,
    v_reason,
    p_expected_revision,
    v_result
  );

  return v_result;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_verified_google_email(p_auth_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select lower(btrim(identity.identity_data ->> 'email'))
  from auth.identities identity
  join auth.users auth_user
    on auth_user.id = identity.user_id
  where identity.user_id = p_auth_user_id
    and identity.provider = 'google'
    and lower(coalesce(
      identity.identity_data ->> 'email_verified',
      'false'
    )) in ('true', '1')
    and coalesce(btrim(identity.identity_data ->> 'email'), '') <> ''
    and lower(split_part(
      btrim(identity.identity_data ->> 'email'),
      '@',
      2
    )) = 'suiyuecare.com'
    -- GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_PRIMARY_EMAIL_RENAME_V1: the verified Google identity email is authoritative.
  order by identity.created_at asc, identity.id asc
  limit 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.finance_complete_verified_google_account_link_v2(p_auth_user_id uuid, p_requested_email text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_tenant_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_google_email text;
  v_candidate_count integer;
  v_google_auth_count integer;
  v_finance public.finance_users%rowtype;
  v_previous_email text;
  v_previous_auth_user_id uuid;
  v_target_revision bigint;
  v_action text;
  v_authorization_id uuid;
  v_projection jsonb;
  v_health jsonb;
  v_error_code text;
  v_failure_status text;
begin
  if p_auth_user_id is null then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', false,
      'status', 'blocked',
      'status_label', '無法完成登入連結',
      'message', '尚未取得有效的 Google 登入工作階段。',
      'next_action', '請重新使用公司 Google 主帳號登入。'
    );
  end if;

  v_google_email := public.finance_verified_google_email(p_auth_user_id);
  if v_google_email is null then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', false,
      'status', 'blocked',
      'status_label', 'Google 身分尚未驗證',
      'message', '系統未取得相同信箱的已驗證公司 Google 身分。',
      'next_action', '請確認使用 Google Workspace 主帳號，不要使用別名信箱。'
    );
  end if;

  if nullif(private.finance_google_normalized_email_v2(p_requested_email), '') is not null
     and private.finance_google_normalized_email_v2(p_requested_email) <> v_google_email then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', false,
      'status', 'conflict',
      'status_label', 'Google 帳號不一致',
      'message', 'Google 回傳的主信箱與本次指定信箱不同。',
      'google_identity_email', v_google_email,
      'next_action', '請重新選擇正確的公司 Google 主帳號。'
    );
  end if;

  select count(distinct identity.user_id)::integer
  into v_google_auth_count
  from auth.identities identity
  join auth.users auth_user on auth_user.id = identity.user_id
  where identity.provider = 'google'
    and lower(coalesce(identity.identity_data ->> 'email_verified', 'false')) in ('true', '1')
    and lower(btrim(coalesce(identity.identity_data ->> 'email', ''))) = v_google_email
    -- GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_PRIMARY_EMAIL_RENAME_V1: auth.users.email may retain the pre-rename address.
    and auth_user.deleted_at is null;

  if v_google_auth_count <> 1 then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', false,
      'status', 'conflict',
      'status_label', 'Google 身分發生衝突',
      'message', '同一個已驗證 Google 信箱對應到非唯一 Auth 身分，系統已停止自動連結。',
      'google_identity_email', v_google_email,
      'conflict_count', v_google_auth_count,
      'next_action', '請由系統管理員確認 Supabase Auth 身分後再重試。'
    );
  end if;

  select count(*)::integer
  into v_candidate_count
  from public.finance_users fu
  where fu.active = true
    and (p_tenant_id is null or fu.tenant_id = p_tenant_id)
    and (
      (
        fu.auth_user_id = p_auth_user_id
        and lower(btrim(fu.email)) = v_google_email
        and fu.google_link_status in ('bound', 'pending_rebind')
      )
      or (
        fu.auth_user_id is null
        and lower(btrim(fu.email)) = v_google_email
        and fu.google_link_status = 'pending_first_login'
      )
      or (
        fu.auth_user_id is not null
        and lower(btrim(coalesce(fu.pending_login_email, ''))) = v_google_email
        and fu.google_link_status = 'pending_rebind'
      )
    );

  if v_candidate_count <> 1 then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', false,
      'status', 'conflict',
      'status_label', '找不到唯一的人員帳號',
      'message', case
        when v_candidate_count = 0 then 'Google 帳號尚未由人資建立或申請換綁。'
        else 'Google 帳號同時符合多筆人員帳號，系統已停止自動連結。'
      end,
      'google_identity_email', v_google_email,
      'candidate_count', v_candidate_count,
      'next_action', '請由執行長、行政主任或人資檢查人員管理的登入信箱。'
    );
  end if;

  select fu.*
  into v_finance
  from public.finance_users fu
  where fu.active = true
    and (p_tenant_id is null or fu.tenant_id = p_tenant_id)
    and (
      (
        fu.auth_user_id = p_auth_user_id
        and lower(btrim(fu.email)) = v_google_email
        and fu.google_link_status in ('bound', 'pending_rebind')
      )
      or (
        fu.auth_user_id is null
        and lower(btrim(fu.email)) = v_google_email
        and fu.google_link_status = 'pending_first_login'
      )
      or (
        fu.auth_user_id is not null
        and lower(btrim(coalesce(fu.pending_login_email, ''))) = v_google_email
        and fu.google_link_status = 'pending_rebind'
      )
    )
  for update;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.finance_users other
    where other.id <> v_finance.id
      and other.active = true
      and (
        other.auth_user_id = p_auth_user_id
        or lower(btrim(other.email)) = v_google_email
        or lower(btrim(coalesce(other.pending_login_email, ''))) = v_google_email
      )
  ) then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', false,
      'status', 'conflict',
      'status_label', '登入信箱已被占用',
      'message', '另一筆啟用中的人員帳號已使用或保留這個 Google 信箱。',
      'finance_user_id', v_finance.id,
      'current_login_email', v_finance.email,
      'pending_login_email', v_finance.pending_login_email,
      'revision', v_finance.google_link_revision,
      'next_action', '請由人資先解除重複登入信箱。'
    );
  end if;

  -- A rebind request never disables or mutates the old verified login.  The
  -- old account may keep entering the system while the replacement identity
  -- is pending, but it must not clear the pending request or bump revision.
  if v_finance.auth_user_id = p_auth_user_id
     and lower(btrim(v_finance.email)) = v_google_email
     and v_finance.google_link_status = 'pending_rebind' then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', true,
      'can_enter', true,
      'status', 'pending_rebind',
      'status_label', '等待新 Google 帳號完成換綁',
      'message', '原 Google 帳號仍可使用；系統會保留換綁申請，直到新帳號驗證完成。',
      'finance_user_id', v_finance.id,
      'current_login_email', v_finance.email,
      'pending_login_email', v_finance.pending_login_email,
      'auth_user_id', v_finance.auth_user_id,
      'revision', v_finance.google_link_revision,
      'old_login_still_active', true,
      'next_action', '請使用新的公司 Google 主帳號登入一次以完成換綁。'
    );
  end if;

  if v_finance.auth_user_id = p_auth_user_id
     and lower(btrim(v_finance.email)) = v_google_email
     and v_finance.google_link_status = 'bound' then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', true,
      'can_enter', true,
      'status', 'bound',
      'status_label', '已可使用 Google 登入',
      'message', '目前 Google 主帳號已完成正式連結。',
      'finance_user_id', v_finance.id,
      'current_login_email', v_finance.email,
      'pending_login_email', null,
      'auth_user_id', v_finance.auth_user_id,
      'revision', v_finance.google_link_revision,
      'old_login_still_active', true,
      'next_action', '可以直接進入會計系統。'
    );
  end if;

  v_previous_email := lower(btrim(v_finance.email));
  v_previous_auth_user_id := v_finance.auth_user_id;
  v_target_revision := v_finance.google_link_revision + 1;
  v_action := case
    when v_previous_auth_user_id is null
     and v_finance.google_link_status = 'pending_first_login'
     and v_previous_email = v_google_email
      then 'verified_first_bind'
    when v_previous_auth_user_id is not null
     and v_finance.google_link_status = 'pending_rebind'
     and lower(btrim(coalesce(v_finance.pending_login_email, ''))) = v_google_email
      then 'verified_rebind'
    else null
  end;

  if v_action is null then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'ok', false,
      'status', 'blocked',
      'status_label', '尚未核准換綁',
      'message', '管理者尚未為這個 Google 主信箱建立換綁請求。',
      'finance_user_id', v_finance.id,
      'current_login_email', v_finance.email,
      'pending_login_email', v_finance.pending_login_email,
      'revision', v_finance.google_link_revision,
      'next_action', '請由執行長、行政主任或人資先在人員管理提出換綁。'
    );
  end if;

  begin
    v_authorization_id := private.finance_google_authorize_mutation_v2(
      v_finance.tenant_id,
      v_finance.id,
      v_action,
      v_previous_email,
      v_google_email,
      v_previous_auth_user_id,
      p_auth_user_id,
      v_target_revision,
      p_auth_user_id
    );

    update public.finance_users fu
    set
      email = v_google_email,
      auth_user_id = p_auth_user_id,
      logging_identity_id = p_auth_user_id::text,
      google_link_status = 'bound',
      pending_login_email = null,
      google_link_revision = v_target_revision,
      google_link_status_detail = '已完成相同主信箱的 Google 身分驗證與正式連結。',
      google_login_verified_at = now(),
      google_last_linked_at = now()
    where fu.tenant_id = v_finance.tenant_id
      and fu.id = v_finance.id
      and fu.google_link_revision = v_finance.google_link_revision;

    if not found then
      raise exception 'Google link revision changed during finalization'
        using errcode = '40001';
    end if;

    v_projection := private.finance_sync_google_link_projections_v2(
      v_finance.tenant_id,
      v_finance.id,
      p_auth_user_id,
      v_previous_email,
      v_google_email
    );

    perform public.finance_activate_verified_google_org_user(
      v_finance.tenant_id,
      v_finance.id,
      p_auth_user_id
    );

    v_health := private.finance_google_projection_health_v2(
      v_finance.tenant_id,
      v_finance.id
    );

    if coalesce((v_health ->> 'ok')::boolean, false) is not true then
      raise exception 'Google account projections did not converge'
        using errcode = '23514';
    end if;

    delete from private.finance_google_link_mutation_authorizations_v2
    where id = v_authorization_id;
  exception
    when others then
      get stacked diagnostics v_error_code = returned_sqlstate;

      -- If Google changed the primary email on the same Auth UUID, accepting
      -- the identity update while Finance stayed on the old canonical email
      -- would invalidate the only live login.  Inside the identity trigger,
      -- rethrow so GoTrue and every projection roll back together.
      if v_action = 'verified_rebind'
         and v_previous_auth_user_id = p_auth_user_id
         and pg_catalog.pg_trigger_depth() > 0 then
        raise;
      end if;

      -- Keep the retryable state and the old canonical binding intact.  A
      -- failed projection must never consume a pending first-login/rebind.
      v_failure_status := v_finance.google_link_status;
      v_target_revision := v_finance.google_link_revision;
      v_authorization_id := private.finance_google_authorize_mutation_v2(
        v_finance.tenant_id,
        v_finance.id,
        'projection_repair',
        v_previous_email,
        v_previous_email,
        v_previous_auth_user_id,
        v_previous_auth_user_id,
        v_target_revision,
        p_auth_user_id
      );

      update public.finance_users fu
      set
        google_link_status_detail =
          'Google 身分已驗證，但正式投影尚未完整同步，可安全重試：'
          || left(v_error_code, 12)
      where fu.tenant_id = v_finance.tenant_id
        and fu.id = v_finance.id;

      delete from private.finance_google_link_mutation_authorizations_v2
      where id = v_authorization_id;

      perform private.finance_google_write_diagnostic_v2(
        v_finance.tenant_id,
        v_finance.id,
        p_auth_user_id,
        'account_link_retry',
        v_failure_status,
        left(coalesce(v_error_code, 'unknown_error'), 80),
        coalesce(v_finance.pending_login_email, v_finance.email),
        v_google_email,
        null,
        jsonb_build_object(
          'phase', 'atomic_finalizer',
          'sqlstate', left(coalesce(v_error_code, 'unknown'), 12)
        ),
        p_auth_user_id
      );

      return jsonb_build_object(
        'ok', false,
        'status', v_failure_status,
        'status_label', case
          when v_failure_status = 'pending_rebind' then '等待新 Google 帳號換綁'
          else '等待首次 Google 登入'
        end,
        'message', 'Google 身分已驗證，但正式帳號投影尚未完整同步；原狀態已保留，可重新嘗試。',
        'finance_user_id', v_finance.id,
        'current_login_email', v_previous_email,
        'pending_login_email', v_finance.pending_login_email,
        'auth_user_id', v_previous_auth_user_id,
        'revision', v_target_revision,
        'error_code', v_error_code,
        'next_action', '請由系統管理員查看帳號連結狀態後重試。'
      );
  end;

  perform private.finance_google_write_diagnostic_v2(
    v_finance.tenant_id,
    v_finance.id,
    p_auth_user_id,
    'bound',
    'bound',
    null,
    v_google_email,
    v_google_email,
    null,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'phase', 'atomic_finalizer',
      'rebind', v_action = 'verified_rebind'
    ),
    p_auth_user_id
  );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'status', 'bound',
    'status_label', '已可使用 Google 登入',
    'message', 'Google 主帳號已完成驗證，前後台帳號與人員投影已同步。',
    'finance_user_id', v_finance.id,
    'current_login_email', v_google_email,
    'pending_login_email', null,
    'auth_user_id', p_auth_user_id,
    'revision', v_target_revision,
    'google_identity_email', v_google_email,
    'projection_health', v_health,
    'next_action', '可以直接進入會計系統。'
  );
end;
$function$
